answer: The labour index (LI) used in the escalation formula is the minimum daily wage of an unskilled adult male mazdoor, as fixed under the applicable law or statutory order. It is taken as of the last date of the quarter immediately preceding the quarter for which the escalation is being calculated (i.e., the last date of the previous quarter) [S1]. If the contract has been extended, the wage is considered as on the last stipulated date of receipt of tenders (including any extension) [S2]. Moreover, the wage applied must be the higher of the rates notified by the Central Government (Ministry of Labour) and the local administration for the work location and relevant period [S2].
